title: Nimble Roasted Syrian Lamb Kebabs
description: Quick and flavorful Syrian lamb kebabs roasted to perfection with fines herbes and steamed in leaf wraps, perfect for a low fat friendly meal.

ingredients.name: fines herbes
ingredients.notes: chopped fresh parsley, dill, and mint

ingredients.name: leaf wraps
ingredients.notes: such as grape or collard green leaves

instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, fines herbes, garlic, lemon juice, salt, and black pepper.
Add the lamb cubes to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Thread the marinated lamb cubes onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Place the skewers on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper and roast for 15 minutes.
While the lamb is roasting, prepare the leaf wraps by blanching them in boiling water for 30 seconds.
After the lamb has roasted for 15 minutes, remove it from the oven and wrap each skewer in a leaf wrap.
Return the wrapped skewers to the oven and steam for an additional 5 minutes.
Remove the skewers from the oven and let them rest for 2 minutes before serving.
